rv.q: San Diego Musical Theatre’s Rock of Ages is a big, loud, delightfully ridiculous blast of ’80s hair-band camp.
With energetic choreography, strong technical design, and a cast that appears to be having as much fun as the audience, Rock of Ages delivers exactly what it promises.
The casting is spot on, vibrant, very sexy, and super fun.
That money was wisely spent to create a lavish, big-cast and highly entertaining production that truly rocks.

cn.t: Critics praise this big, loud production as delightfully ridiculous '80s camp that knows exactly what it is, with strong vocals, energetic choreography, a live band, and lavish staging that transports audiences to 1987 Sunset Strip.
